item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00501","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C02","C25","C16"],"selected_candidate_label":"C02","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C02 plausibly supplied a concrete and material drafting template. It shares the child's unusually detailed recital sequence: the 1947 GATT agreement and Proclamation 2761A; later supplementary agreements and Schedule XX-1956; identification of the prevailing concession; a Tariff Commission section 7 investigation finding increased imports and serious injury; a finding of the necessary remedy; and the determination that modifying the concession is appropriate to carry out GATT. The operative clauses also closely parallel the child: identical statutory and Article XIX authority, effectiveness until otherwise proclaimed, modification of a specific Schedule XX-1956 item, mandatory application of the modified item, and suspension of inconsistent prior proclamations. C25 and C16 use closely related escape-clause machinery, but neither matches the child's overall recital and operative structure as closely as C02.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"Whereas, pursuant to the authority vested in him by the Constitution and the statutes, including section 350 of the Tariff Act of 1930, as amended ... on October 30, 1947 the President entered into a trade agreement ...
